How to use
ReplyVibe AI.

Your smarter way to reply on X.
Generate thoughtful replies in just a few clicks.

01

Install ReplyVibe

Add ReplyVibe AI to Chrome and pin the extension to your browser toolbar.

02

Sign in with Google

Open ReplyVibe AI and sign in using your Google account.

03

Choose an X Post

Visit X.com ↗ and find a post you want to reply to. Open ReplyVibe using the available reply action.

04

Choose Your Style

Select your preferred reply tone and length. Choose from tones such as Professional, Friendly, Funny, Witty, Supportive, and more.

05

Generate & Copy

Click Generate Reply to get an AI-powered suggestion. Review it, make any changes, and click Copy.

06

Post Your Reply

Return to X, paste your copied reply, and post it when you’re ready.

✦ You're always in control.

ReplyVibe never posts automatically.

FREE OR PRO?
